papers.title: Selective laser melting (SLM) of AlSi12Mg lattice structures
papers.first_author_affiliation: RMIT Centre for Additive Manufacture, RMIT University, Melbourne, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Martin Leary
corresponding_authors.affiliation: RMIT Centre for Additive Manufacture, RMIT University, Melbourne, Australia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了AlSi12Mg晶格结构的SLM制造，未涉及生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽，但晶格结构概念可转移。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not use a biomedical material (Ti or CoCr), does not evaluate stress shielding or osseointegration, and does not include fatigue testing relevant to implant longevity.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究AlSi12Mg合金晶格结构的SLM工艺可行性及力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化技术制备不同单元构型的晶格结构，并进行准静态压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺参数与晶格相对密度、弹性模量和屈服强度的关系。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验力学测试验证有限元模型预测的准确性。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the manufacturability and mechanical properties of AlSi12Mg lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate lattice structures with different unit cell topologies, followed by quasi-static compression tests.
summary_en.result: Relationships between processing parameters, relative density, elastic modulus, and yield strength were established.
summary_en.validation: Finite element model predictions were validated against experimental mechanical testing results.
